result.topic_en: Draft passage on the continuity and differentiability, with respect to the interior point O_0, of the boundary integral representing u, followed by a draft passage defining the order of connectivity of a surface and how cross-cuts and other cuts change it.

methods.what: Boundary-integral (Green) representation of a function u at an interior point, used to show smooth dependence on that point
methods.quote: $\int \log r \frac{\partial u}{\partial p} - u \frac{\partial \log r}{\partial p}\, ds$

methods.what: Argument that derivatives of the kernel log r with respect to the interior point are rational functions with only powers of r in the denominator, hence continuous and finite while O_0 stays in the interior
methods.quote:
durch gebrochene rationale Functionen dieser Größe
ausgedrückt werden, die nur Potenzen von r im Nenner enthalten

methods.quote:
Diese Zahl kann {+füglich als+} Ordnung des Zusammenhangs einer Fläche [-be-]
[-zeichnet-] werden

methods.what: A cross-cut lowers the order of connectivity by 1
methods.quote: durch jeden Querschnitt um 1 erniedrigt – nach der Definition –

methods.what: A cut from a boundary point to an interior point leaves the order of connectivity unchanged
methods.quote:
durch einen [-Schnitt-] Rückschnitt d.h. einen von einem Begrenzungspunkte, ohne sich zu
schneiden, nach einem innern Punkte gehende Linie nicht geändert

methods.what: An interior cut joining two interior points raises the order of connectivity by 1
methods.quote:
durch einen inneren Schnitt, eine [-...-] zwei {+innere+} Punkte [-...-], ohne sich zu
schneiden, verbindende Linie um 1 erhöht

methods.what: A closed non-self-intersecting interior curve leaves the order of connectivity unchanged, since it is composed of an interior cut and a cross-cut
